profile.headline: Software Engineer on Google Beam
profile.summary:
Seth recently received his PhD in Computer Graphics, Virtual Reality, and Interactive Data Visualization. He has been specifically focused on VR applications for facilitating design collaboration between artists and scientific data researchers, as well as tools for enhancing doctor-patient communication.

Seth sees interactive computer graphics as a valuable tool for enabling exploration and engagement, whether in the creation of video games, data analysis applications, or educational tools.

Seth's StrengthsFinder strengths are Responsibility, Analytical, Strategic, Individualization, and Developer.

positions.title: PHD Candidate
positions.description:
• Develop interdisciplinary data visualization computer graphics applications
• Facilitate Labs, grade course material, and conduct office hours for Computer Science courses

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Research AR/VR rendering and user interface techniques for 3D data visualization
• Develop software to support interdisciplinary 3D visualization research tasks
• Produce and direct videos demonstrating lab projects

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Develop new Student Projects for Junior-Level Software Design class 
• Facilitate class discussions and labs for 100+ students per semester
• Establish grading rubrics for diverse array of assignments

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description: • Research GPU profiling techniques for mobile graphics applications

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Researched new, high-performance loading algorithms for digital content
• Gained experience using industry-level version control and testing for graphical end-user software

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Created and maintained automated testing infrastructure for cross-platform product
• Configured Windows Server and Linux virtual machines
• Tested and debugged product written in C  
• Developed product API packages in a Git-based team environment using Python and C#

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description:
• Guided family science projects in hands-on workshops 
 • Lead a team of mentors in coaching students in summer science camps 
 • Developed and oversaw curriculum for an ongoing Lego Robotics camp

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description: Assisted students in math, physics, and computer science course work in a peer setting
